items.name: Colorado Western Slope 2020

venue.name: SpringHill Suites Grand Junction Downtown
venue.address: 236 Main Street, Grand Junction, Colorado 81501 USA

items.information: # The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * No outside food and drink. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.

items.name: Tramsheds Twin Saturday 2020
items.information: # The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. This is a **twin competition** alongside [Tramsheds Twin Sunday 2020](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TramshedsTwinSunday2020). **You will be permitted to compete at ONLY ONE of the two competitions.** If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each day has a different set of events. ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
